## MASTER PROMPT USE GUIDE

A Master Prompt is not a normal one-time prompt. It is a complete reusable AI system where the character, camera style, story DNA, duration, audio, continuity, negative rules, and output format are already defined.

**Simple workflow:**

1. Open a new ChatGPT or Claude chat and paste the complete Master Prompt.
2. Type: **“Give me 10 topics.”**
3. Select your favorite idea: **“Topic 4.”**
4. Then type: **“Make full prompt.”**
5. For changes, do not paste the full Master Prompt again. Simply say: **“Keep everything the same, change the location,” “make the hook stronger,” “make it 15 seconds,” “make the ending funnier,” or “keep the same character.”**
6. For more ideas, type: **“Give me 10 more topics”** or **“Next video.”**

Think of the Master Prompt as your permanent **Creative Director + Script Writer + Camera Director + Prompt Engineer.**

**The Master Prompt defines HOW to create.
Your next command defines WHAT to create.**

For a new chat, paste the Master Prompt again for the safest workflow.
